angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 166,968 km at 51.85 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 19.2875 +/- 0.0194 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 51.85 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.24 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Parviainen et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.170P/abstract): 166,968 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.23 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Parviainen et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.170P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3200 +/- 170 K from Parviainen et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.170P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Parviainen et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.170P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2266.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.039, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2266 (pscomppars): spectral type M5.0+0.5-0.5, from Parviainen et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.170P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2266: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2266 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.16716, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2266 (pscomppars): age 0.3 Gyr, from Parviainen et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.170P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
